en.headline: Flu vaccination programmes start 17 September, a week earlier than last year
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said about 1.3 million doses have been procured for the 2026-27 season, with school outreach and public clinics opening as influenza remains active.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said the government's 2026-27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes will begin on 17 September, a week earlier than last year, as the new school year opens and influenza activity remains high.

CHP Controller Dr Edwin Tsui Lok-kin said the government has procured about 1.3 million doses from two licensed pharmaceutical wholesalers, covering four products across three platforms: injectable inactivated vaccines, a nasal-spray live-attenuated vaccine and an injectable recombinant vaccine. He said influenza has stayed active since late June and that school gatherings after the start of term can speed up transmission.

Tsui said analysis of previous seasons showed unvaccinated residents aged 65 or above in residential care homes had about four times the rate of severe complications of those who had been vaccinated, while unvaccinated children had about five times the rate of vaccinated children. Coverage remains low among infants aged six months to two years and among adults aged 18 to 49 with chronic illness, he said.

The Hospital Authority will offer free jabs from 17 September at public hospitals and outpatient clinics for eligible patients, including children and adolescents under 18, people aged 50 or above, pregnant women, eligible people with intellectual or physical disabilities, adults aged 18 to 49 with chronic conditions, and long-stay inpatients. Adults aged 18 or above should register on eHealth before vaccination. From 8 October, selected family medicine clinics will also vaccinate referred poultry and pig-industry workers.

zh.headline: 季節性流感疫苗接種計劃9月17日展開 較去年提早一周
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示已採購約130萬劑疫苗供2026/27年度計劃使用，學校外展及公營診所同步開打，現時流感仍處高水平。
body: 衞生防護中心公布，2026/27年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃將於9月17日展開，較去年提早一周。中心指本港自6月底進入流感季節，活躍程度仍然偏高，開學後學生聚集或加快傳播。
衞生防護中心總監徐樂堅表示，政府已向兩間持牌藥物批發商採購約130萬劑疫苗，涵蓋四款產品、三個技術平台，包括注射式滅活疫苗、噴鼻式減活疫苗及注射式重組疫苗。他說接種可降低兒童及長者重症、死亡及入院風險。
徐樂堅指出，未接種疫苗的65歲或以上安老院舍長者出現嚴重併發症的比率，約為已接種者的四倍；未接種的兒童則約為已接種兒童的五倍。六個月至兩歲幼童，以及18至49歲長期病患者的接種率仍然偏低。
醫管局將由9月17日起，在公立醫院及門診診所為合資格病人接種，包括六個月至未滿18歲及50歲或以上人士、孕婦、合資格智障或傷殘人士、18至49歲長期病患者，以及長期住院病人。18歲或以上人士接種前須先以醫健通登記。由10月8日起，選定家庭醫學診所亦會為政府轉介的家禽從業員及養豬屠宰業人士接種。
